query.description: In the connection's language: LogQL (Loki), Logging query language (GCP), Logs Insights QL (CloudWatch), Lucene query_string (OpenSearch). Empty matches everything except on Loki.

from.description: ISO-8601 with offset (2026-10-22T14:00:00+02:00) or relative: -15m, -1h, -2d, now-30m

source.description: Optional: one log group (CloudWatch), index pattern (OpenSearch) or resource name (GCP) listed by describe_connection.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous logs_search call: older entries.
